items.title: Henry A. "Hank" Kmen Interview, 1963-02-13
items.q: Jack Denny, huh? Yeah, Jack Denny was one of the bands that got nationally popular through radio... As I remember one time he had a Whitman Sampler album.

ctx.x: Did you take lessons on the same melody track?

I never took lessons on the saxophone, the clarinet. I sometimes was afraid to take lessons. I didn't want to mess around trying to change my way of playing. As long as I was getting along, alright. Well, actually you learn an awful lot from the college you worked with. A kid in those days, I don't guess that this is ever, it's certainly not possible anymore, it may never be possible again in America, but you could go, you could draw a thirty mile radius, a thirty miles, a circle, a thirty mile radius around my…
That's funny, I don't remember anything about him at all.
